metadata.title: Clicked like I’m allergic to shooting and STILL got a kill? Valorant aim is a mystery
metadata.description:
Me: flailing mouse like it owes me money
Enemy: probably uninstalling already
How did that land? No clue, but I’m counting it
Tap if your panic shots surprise even YOU!

Click if your aim ever took a day off but still got the job done!
